title: Existence of the difference derivation into diagonal conormal
statement: For every scheme morphism f, there exists a relative derivation from the structure sheaf to the diagonal conormal satisfying the normalized difference formula on compatible opens and kernel sections.

proof.text: For each open U set W_U = p₁⁻¹(U) ∩ p₂⁻¹(U). The composites δ ≫ pᵢ are identities, so U ≤ δ⁻¹(W_U). The section p₂*(a) − p₁*(a) is killed by δ.app W_U, by appLE composition. The proved upstream Scheme.Modules.range_map_kernelι therefore supplies a section k_U(a) of the actual kernel I on W_U; Scheme.Modules.injective_map_kernelι makes it unique. Injectivity also proves k_U is additive.

Use the unit η : I → δ_*δ*I of the chosen tensor-pullback adjunction. Define c(U,W,hδ)(s) by restricting η_W(s) to U, and d_U(a) = c(U,W_U,hδ)(k_U(a)). These are explicit additive maps, using only a uniquely determined kernel lift. Naturality of η and functoriality of restriction show c is compatible with shrinking W or U. If s on a compatible W has image p₂*(a) − p₁*(a), then W ≤ W_U and naturality plus injectivity of the kernel inclusion identifies s with k_U(a)|_W. This gives exactly the required normalized local formula.

Write p and q for the two projection maps on sections of W_U. Injectivity of the kernel inclusion and the ring identity p(ab) − q(ab) = p(a)(p(b) − q(b)) + q(b)(p(a) − q(a)) give k_U(ab) = p(a)·k_U(b) + q(b)·k_U(a). Linearity of η, followed by semilinearity of restriction, sends a scalar r to δ.appLE(r). Since δ ≫ pᵢ = id, the scalars p(a) and q(b) become a and b on U. Thus d_U(ab) = a·d_U(b) + b·d_U(a).

For V ≤ U, the inclusion W_V ≤ W_U and naturality of the two projection maps identify k_U(a)|_{W_V} with k_V(a|_V), again by injectivity. The restriction identities for c then show d commutes with restrictions. For a section from an open of S, the equality p₁ ≫ f = p₂ ≫ f makes the projection difference zero; its kernel lift and hence d are zero. Apply the proved source constructor Scheme.Hom.derivationMk to these additive maps, their Leibniz rule, restriction compatibility and base vanishing. Its section maps are the constructed d_U, so the formula from step 2 proves the theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_diagonalConormalDerivation_core (f : X ⟶ S) :
    ∃ D : (diagonalConormal f).val.Derivation' f.pullbackPresheafToPresheaf,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (W : (pullback f f).Opens)
        (h₁ : W ≤ (pullback.fst f f) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (h₂ : W ≤ (pullback.snd f f) ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (hδ : U ≤ (pullback.diagonal f) ⁻¹ᵁ W)
        (a : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(kernel (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
          (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom), W)),
        (kernel.ι (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
          (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom)).val.app (op W) s =
            (pullback.snd f f).appLE U W h₂ a -
              (pullback.fst f f).appLE U W h₁ a →
        D.d (X := op U) a =
          (diagonalConormal f).presheaf.map (homOfLE hδ).op
            (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
              (pullback.diagonal f))).unit.app
                (kernel (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
                  (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom))).val.app (op W) s)
